Yogaś cittavṛttinirodhaḥ /I.2/
Yogaś citta-vṛtti-nirodhaḥ /I.2/

« Le yoga est l'arrêt des fluctuations du mental. »
« Le yoga est la restriction des fluctuations du mental. »
428

Tasya lakṣaṇa-abhidhitsayā–idaṃ sūtraṃ pravavṛte
429 / Yogaś citta-vṛtti-nirodhaḥ / Sarva-
śabda-agrahaṇāt saṃprajñāto'py ity ākhyāyate
430 / Cittaṃ hi prakhyā-pravṛtti-sthiti-śīlatvāt
tri-guṇaṃ / Prakhyā-rūpaṃ hi citta-sattvaṃ rajas-tamobhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭam aiśvarya-viṣaya-
priyaṃ bhavati / Tad eva
431 tamasā–anuviddham adharma-ajñāna-avairāgya-anaiśvarya-
upagaṃ bhavati / Tad eva prakṣīṇa-moha-āvaraṇaṃ sarvataḥ pradyotamānam anuviddhaṃ
rajo-mātrayā
432 dharma-jñāna-vairāgya-aiśvarya-upagaṃ bhavati / Tad eva rajo-leśa-m
